issues: Laid out in a 480×270 design space and scaled up, so tile titles were 5–10px-class text that stayed unreadable
Tiles were the same blue-purple gradient blocks with geometric art; all 12 looked alike and read neither as photos nor as a product
The reflow had no cause: the layout just morphed on its own, with nothing showing what triggered it
One smoothstep curve for everything with rotation landing together with position, so B to C never settled; the C state had no type and the last frame was not a composed image
changes: Sand look (warm beige, terracotta): a summer set in Folio, a fictional photo library, with 12 procedurally drawn warm film-style photos (sunset, dunes, arch, misty ridge, pool, citrus and more)
Added cause: a Grid / Mosaic / Cascade segmented control top right whose terracotta pill slides first (stretching mid-way) and the tiles follow 4f later
Layered curves: position uses a decisive bezier(0.75,0,0.15,1), size lands 2f later and rotation 4f later with one light overshoot; tiles lift 3.5% with a softer, larger shadow while moving
Three states, three tones: in B the hero tile gets an 84px serif caption rising word by word; in C the tiles grow white print borders and are dealt out one by one
Native 1920 typography: 48px wordmark, 30px control, and in C a 124px serif headline 'Summer, in sequence.' with a 32px subline bottom left, so the last frame is a finished album poster
214f: 22f build-in, hold A, A to B, 36f hold B, B to C, 34f hold C, with a very slow 2.5% camera push throughout
